feeds.title: Kathy Temean
feeds.description: The goal of this blog is to bring and share information about Writing and Illustrating for children to published and unpublished authors and illustrators. I will post information I acquire from my interactions with editors and agents in the industry and share thoughts and techniques of other writers and illustrators in the field. I'm the former Regional Advisor in New Jersey for the SCBWI. It was a lot of work, but writing and illustrating and helping people is a passion of mine.

feeds.title: Let's Talk Picture Books
feeds.description: Discover Children's picture book and comic reviews, illustrator interviews, book exchanges, and more from a design and illustration perspective. Mel Schuit (she/her/hers) is a picture book enthusiast with an MA in Children's Literature, an MFA in Writing for Children, and a BA in Studio Art. Let's Talk Picture Books started as a way for her to catalog the illustration styles and techniques she found in her own picture book and comic book collections.

feeds.title: Society of Children's Book Writers & Illustrators Blog
feeds.description: Learn the essentials of publishing children's books, improve your craft, and stay current with industry practices. The Official Blog of the society of children's book writers and illustrators. Authored by Lee Wind. The Society of Children's Book Writers & Illustrators supports quality children's books and the artists who make them.

feeds.title: Debbie Ridpath Ohi Blog
feeds.description: Covers advise about writing and illustrating books for young people, uplifting art, book process, book news, book promotion, and marketing tips. Authored by Debbie Ridpath Ohi, a children's book author and illustrator.

feeds.title: Julie Rowan-Zoch
feeds.description: Explore the blog for recommendations of children's illustration books. I'm a reformed graphic designer, concocting and sculpting story ideas and illustrations - every day.

feeds.title: Dick King-Smith Blog
feeds.description: Read more about Dick KIng-Smith's life, books, his granddaughter's accounts of him and more! Dick King-Smith is the author of over 130 children's books including Babe (The Sheep-Pig), The Hedgeheg and The Water Horse.

feeds.title: Cathy Morrison Blog
feeds.description: A children's book illustrator passionate about the environment, science and nature. Explore the blog to follow my life happenings, musings and more! I'm a children's book illustrator working from our green-constructed home in Colorado.

feeds.title: Anna Raff Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on Anna Raff, new book releases and more! Anna Raff is an award-winning illustrator living in New York City, who has illustrated several books for children. Before her career as an illustrator, Anna was a designer at The Metropolitan Museum of Art and several children's book publishers in New York City.

feeds.title: Picture Book Illustration
feeds.description: Explore the children's illustration arts from all over the world in this blog! Children's Illustration Blog is brought to you by Shelley Davies & Julie Fortenberry.

feeds.title: Jennifer K Mann
feeds.description: The blog of children's book author and illustrator Jennifer K Mann. I am a children's book author and illustrator. I used to be an architect, but I liked drawing the people and the stories better than the buildings, so I switched to making books for children. I post here now and then about my art, process stuff, information about my books, and this and that about the things I love.

feeds.title: Jujubee Illustrations
feeds.description: Explore sketches, illustrations and information on the life of, Julie Olson, a children's book illustrator. Julie is a freelance illustrator working in the children's book industry.

feeds.title: Anthony Browne Books Blog
feeds.description: Anthony Browne is one of the world's most celebrated creators of picture books, with classics such as Gorilla, Voices in the Park, Willy the Wimp and Zoo to his name. Keep an eye on this blog for regular updates from Anthony Browne himself.

feeds.title: Kateri Kramer Blog
feeds.description: The blog features articles on children's illustration book reviews, Kateri's journey as an artist and illustrator and more! Kateri Kramer is a freelance illustrator and writer. I'm a book designer creating covers that are eye-catching and memorable. I want you to judge a book by its cover.

feeds.title: Illustrations By Sumitra Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about illustrating for children's books in this blog. | am Sumitra, a digital artist, and children's book illustrator. |have worked on several projects related to children's products and have worked on some books too.
